text: Phase 5 implemented immutable scheduler-neutral ReplicateJobPlan lowering, full-versus-exact execution provenance, optional ExactRefitReduction core/update/lift capability, concrete thin-SVD paired cross-covariance reduction, and associative exact-count/mergeable-moment reducers.
